title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: Base Rate Ladders
content:
Each tier of the Savings & Money Market Accounts family pays base interest from its own ladder of balance bands. This reference gives every tier's ladder, the way the ladder is laid over a balance, the smallest end-of-day balance that earns anything at all, and whether interest built up since the last cycle close is paid out when the account is closed part-way through a cycle.

## Ladders

A band starts at the floor shown and runs up to the next floor; the rate is an annual percentage yield.

| Tier | Band floors (USD) and APY | Method | Smallest end-of-day balance that earns (USD) | Accrued interest paid on mid-cycle closure |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter Savings | from 0.00: 0.05% | tiered | 10.00 | no, forfeited |
| Statement Savings | from 0.00: 0.05%; from 10000.00: 0.10% | tiered | 10.00 | no, forfeited |
| Goal Builder Savings | from 0.00: 0.25% | tiered | 0.00 | no, forfeited |
| Money Market Account | from 0.00: 0.10%; from 2500.00: 0.50%; from 25000.00: 1.00%; from 100000.00: 1.50% | tiered | 0.00 | yes |
| Premier Money Market | from 0.00: 0.25%; from 10000.00: 1.25%; from 50000.00: 2.00%; from 250000.00: 2.50% | blended | 0.00 | yes |
| Private Client Money Market | from 0.00: 1.50%; from 100000.00: 2.75%; from 500000.00: 3.25% | blended | 0.00 | yes |

## The two methods in brief

- **Tiered**: the entire balance takes the rate of the highest floor the balance has reached.
- **Blended**: the balance is cut into slices at the floors, and each slice takes the rate of its own band.

## Illustration (hypothetical balance)

Take an end-of-day balance of 60000.00.

- On Money Market Account (tiered), the highest floor reached is 25000.00, so the full 60000.00 is rated at 1.00%.
- On Premier Money Market (blended), the first 10000.00 is rated at 0.25%, the slice from 10000.00 up to 50000.00 (that is, 40000.00) at 1.25%, and the remaining 10000.00 above 50000.00 at 2.00%.

## Quick answers

**Does a Starter Savings balance of 9.99 earn base interest that day?** No; it is below that tier's 10.00 threshold.

**If a Statement Savings account closes mid-cycle, is the interest built up since the last close paid?** No, it is forfeited on that tier. The three money market tiers pay it.
